access_grant_subject_shape.name: access_grant_subject_shape
access_grant_subject_shape.value:
("core"."access_grant"."subject_kind" = 'role' AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_role" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_grant"."subject_kind" <> 'role' AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_grant"."subject_role" IS NULL)

access_policy_target_shape.name: access_policy_target_shape
access_policy_target_shape.value:
("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" = 'workspace' AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" IN ('group', 'membership') AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" = 'link' AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NULL)
        OR ("core"."access_policy"."target_kind" = 'resource' AND "core"."access_policy"."target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."access_policy"."resource_kind" IS NOT NULL)

api_key_revoked_shape.name: api_key_revoked_shape
api_key_revoked_shape.value:
("core"."api_key"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("core"."api_key"."revoked_reason" IS NULL)
    AND ("core"."api_key"."revoked_reason" IS NULL
      OR "core"."api_key"."revoked_reason" IN ('revoked', 'rotated', 'creator_inactive', 'erased'))

webhook_endpoint_disabled_shape.name: webhook_endpoint_disabled_shape
webhook_endpoint_disabled_shape.value:
"core"."webhook_endpoint"."enabled" = ("core"."webhook_endpoint"."disabled_reason" IS NULL)
    AND ("core"."webhook_endpoint"."disabled_reason" IS NULL OR "core"."webhook_endpoint"."disabled_reason" IN ('gone', 'failing', 'manual'))

break_glass_session_operator_shape.name: break_glass_session_operator_shape
break_glass_session_operator_shape.value:
char_length("core"."break_glass_session"."operator") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "core"."break_glass_session"."operator" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
    AND char_length("core"."break_glass_session"."os_user") BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND "core"."break_glass_session"."os_user" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

break_glass_session_closed_shape.name: break_glass_session_closed_shape
break_glass_session_closed_shape.value:
("core"."break_glass_session"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("core"."break_glass_session"."close_reason" IS NULL)
    AND ("core"."break_glass_session"."closed_at" IS NULL OR "core"."break_glass_session"."closed_at" >= "core"."break_glass_session"."opened_at")
    AND ("core"."break_glass_session"."close_reason" IS NULL OR "core"."break_glass_session"."close_reason" IN ('closed', 'notification_failed'))

break_glass_session_notified_shape.name: break_glass_session_notified_shape
break_glass_session_notified_shape.value: ("core"."break_glass_session"."notified_at" IS NULL OR "core"."break_glass_session"."notified_at" >= "core"."break_glass_session"."opened_at") AND ("core"."break_glass_session"."statements" = 0 OR "core"."break_glass_session"."notified_at" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_purge_due_idx.name: workspace_purge_due_idx
workspace_purge_due_idx.where: "core"."workspace"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."workspace"."purged_at" IS NULL

workspace_purge_shape.name: workspace_purge_shape
workspace_purge_shape.value: ("core"."workspace"."purge_after" IS NULL OR "core"."workspace"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("core"."workspace"."purged_at" IS NULL OR ("core"."workspace"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."workspace"."purge_after" IS NOT NULL))

dsar_request_completion_shape.name: dsar_request_completion_shape
dsar_request_completion_shape.value: "core"."dsar_request"."status" = 'completed' OR ("core"."dsar_request"."completion_note" IS NULL AND "core"."dsar_request"."export_sha256" IS NULL)

credential_kind_shape.name: credential_kind_shape
credential_kind_shape.value:
("core"."credential"."kind" <> 'passkey' OR ("core"."credential"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."credential"."public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."credential"."sign_count" IS NOT NULL))
        AND ("core"."credential"."kind" NOT IN ('totp', 'password') OR "core"."credential"."secret" IS NOT NULL)

invite_delegate.name: invite_delegate
invite_delegate.value:
("core"."invite"."principal_membership_id" IS NULL) = ("core"."invite"."delegate_scope" IS NULL)
  AND ("core"."invite"."role" = 'delegate') = ("core"."invite"."principal_membership_id" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("core"."invite"."delegate_scope" IS NULL OR "core"."invite"."delegate_scope" IN ('all', 'data_room', 'updates'))

membership_delegate_scope.name: membership_delegate_scope
membership_delegate_scope.value:
("core"."membership"."role" = 'delegate') = ("core"."membership"."delegate_scope" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("core"."membership"."delegate_scope" IS NULL OR "core"."membership"."delegate_scope" IN ('all', 'data_room', 'updates'))

workspace_export_sha256_shape.name: workspace_export_sha256_shape
workspace_export_sha256_shape.value: ("core"."workspace_export"."sha256" IS NULL OR octet_length("core"."workspace_export"."sha256") = 32) AND ("core"."workspace_export"."manifest_sha256" IS NULL OR octet_length("core"."workspace_export"."manifest_sha256") = 32)

search_entry_acl_shape.name: search_entry_acl_shape
search_entry_acl_shape.value: ("core"."search_entry"."acl_kind" = 'groups') = ("core"."search_entry"."acl_groups" IS NOT NULL) AND ("core"."search_entry"."acl_kind" = 'resource') = ("core"."search_entry"."acl_resource_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "core"."search_entry"."acl_resource_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("core"."search_entry"."acl_path" IS NULL OR "core"."search_entry"."acl_kind" = 'resource')
